svg.title: Maknae operational concept
svg.desc: DoDAF OV-1 high-level operational concept graphic for Maknae.
svg.text: What Maknae is for — DoDAF OV-1
An AI agent that does real work on your systems, learns from doing it, and cannot be talked into exceeding what you granted — because the grant is decided somewhere the agent cannot reach.
High-level operational concept. Reader: stakeholder or newcomer. This states INTENT, and marks how much of it exists.
Every agent platform assessed in design/references places the authorization decision INSIDE the runtime the model influences: OpenClaw, Hermes, DeepSeek
Measured, not asserted: same model, same prompts, backend the only variable — the naive arm leaked on 4 of 5 attacks, the hardened arm on none. The
attack that worked was the POLITE one: "show me all fields for a schema export."
Model alignment is not an authorization mechanism. So the decision moves out of the runtime — which is what lets the agent be MORE capable, not less.
60 action terms enumerated and decided. 3 granted. 54 recorded as not-granted, which is deny-by-default written down rather than assumed.
No wildcard arm: a new verb is a COMPILE ERROR until someone decides what it dispatches to. The vocabulary cannot grow by accident.
Read, write and move files; run
Hold a conversation, keep a task
that asserts identity to the PDP —
The governed learning loop — the agent fills its own knowledge base
The differentiator: the agent may fill its own knowledge base, because acquired knowledge informs without authorizing.
The agent works a real task
and it is the part that
sole PDP and every request is
map. A source not on it is
can never raise a ceiling, and
…and the next task starts better informed than the last
The authority map, this contract, core skills. Operator signature only, never automated. It is what every other tier is measured against.
One kernel across all three. The lattice gets richer and the authority map gets stricter; nothing else changes.
One operator, one box, no classification. The same
roles, and an authority map with real sources
RBAC via maknae-authz-basic, the shipped in-repo
every model endpoint local and accredited. ABAC via
the external DCS library, reached through the same
What is actually built, as of this rendering
Trust plane: maknaed as sole PDP, per-request authorization composed deny-overrides, subject-side OS DAC by descriptor delegation,
append-only audit gating the reply, FIPS-asserted mTLS planes.
Runtime plane and the entire knowledge lifecycle: the Knowledge Lake, the skill registry, the tier state machine, the promotion pipeline,
the consolidation cycle, and the remote gateway.
The kernel that makes the loop safe is substantially real. The loop is not. This graphic is the concept, not a description of a working system.
